newsitem.title: USA: Filipino senator calls for moral revolution.
newsitem.headline: Filipino senator calls for moral revolution.

text.p: A leading Filipino senator on Tuesday urged the United States to lead a moral revolution to halt what he said was an institutionalized "war against the unborn."
Philippine Senate Majority Leader Francisco Tatad in a speech said a new moral code was needed that "upholds for everyone, everywhere and at all times, the primacy of the human being."
He spoke at a U.S.-Southeast Asia Partnership conference in Washington attended by delegates from the United States, Thailand and the Philippines.
